mossy.addFriend.title: Add Friend
mossy.addFriend.header.title: Join a friend
mossy.addFriend.header.subtitle: Paste their Mossy join code, or add a network address when discovery needs help.

mossy.addFriend.section.body: A join code connects to a friend's open LAN world through Mossy. A network address is a host:port fallback.
mossy.addFriend.section.help: Ask your friend to open their world to LAN first, then paste the code they copied from Mossy.
mossy.addFriend.status.waiting: Waiting for a join code or network address.
mossy.addFriend.status.readyCode: Ready to join by Mossy code. Your friend must keep the LAN world open.
mossy.addFriend.status.readyAddress: Ready to save this network address for discovery fallback.
mossy.addFriend.status.prompt: Paste a Mossy join code, or use host:port like 203.0.113.42:41030
mossy.addFriend.status.ownCode: This is your own join code. Ask your friend to copy theirs.
mossy.addFriend.syntheticWorld.name: Friend's LAN world
mossy.settings.title: Mossy Settings
mossy.settings.header.title: Mossy options
mossy.settings.header.subtitle: Keep the defaults unless a friend or server host asks you to change them.
mossy.settings.connection.title: Connection
mossy.settings.meshId.title: Network name
mossy.settings.meshId.hint: Friends must use the same network name to find each other.
mossy.settings.port.title: Listening port
mossy.settings.port.hint: Change this only if another app already uses the port.
mossy.settings.maxPeers.title: Friend limit
mossy.settings.hello.title: Discovery interval
mossy.settings.hello.hint: How often Mossy announces your world, in seconds.
mossy.settings.trackers.title: Trackers
mossy.settings.trackers.hint: Optional public rendezvous servers, separated by commas.
mossy.settings.savedFriends.title: Saved friends
mossy.settings.savedFriends.body: Network addresses you added manually show up here.
mossy.settings.savedFriends.empty.title: No saved friends
mossy.settings.savedFriends.empty.body: You can still discover friends automatically. Add a network address only when discovery needs help.
mossy.settings.joinCode.title: Your join code
mossy.settings.joinCode.body: Share this after opening your world to LAN. Your friend can paste it in Add Friend and join directly.
mossy.settings.joinCode.manualHint: If the join code cannot reach you, share your reachable IP or host with this port.
mossy.settings.status.local: Changes are saved locally on this computer.
mossy.settings.status.copiedJoinCode: Copied your join code. Your friend can paste it in Add Friend after your LAN world is open.
mossy.settings.status.joinCodeNotReady: Join code is not ready yet.
mossy.settings.status.savedRestarted: Saved. Mossy restarted with the new options.
mossy.settings.error.port: Listening port must be between 1 and 65535.
mossy.settings.error.maxPeers: Friend limit must be between 1 and 500.
mossy.settings.error.hello: Discovery interval must be between 1 and 300 seconds.
mossy.friends.title: Mossy Friends
mossy.friends.header.title: Friends' worlds
mossy.friends.header.subtitle: Worlds shared with you appear here automatically. Pick one and join.
mossy.friends.available.title: Available worlds
mossy.friends.available.body: These are online worlds your friends are publishing now.
mossy.friends.selected.title: Selected world
mossy.friends.selected.body: Check who is online and how Mossy will connect before joining.
mossy.friends.empty.title: No shared worlds yet
mossy.friends.empty.body: Ask a friend to open their world to LAN with Mossy running, or add their network address if discovery needs help.

mossy.friends.choose.body: When a friend appears, Mossy will show whether it can use a private tunnel or a direct fallback.
mossy.friends.route.privateHint: Mossy will try the private route first.
mossy.friends.route.addressHint: This friend is only reachable through a normal server address right now.
mossy.friends.status.starting: Starting Mossy... worlds will appear when the connection is ready.
mossy.friends.status.waiting: Mossy is ready. Waiting for friends to share a world.
mossy.friends.routeDescription.private: Mossy will open a tunnel to your friend's world. No address sharing needed.
mossy.friends.routeDescription.address: Mossy found a normal address for this world and can use it as a fallback.
mossy.friends.routeDescription.unreachab: Keep Mossy open or add a network address so this world can be reached.
mossy.diagnostics.title: Connection Help
mossy.diagnostics.header.title: Connection help
mossy.diagnostics.header.subtitle: Use this when worlds do not appear or a join attempt fails.
mossy.diagnostics.summary.title: What Mossy sees

mossy.diagnostics.events.body: Newest connection messages are at the bottom.

mossy.diagnostics.noActivity.body: Try refreshing, sharing a world, or joining a friend's world to create connection messages.
mossy.diagnostics.statusHint.notReady: Open settings, check your port, or restart Minecraft if this does not change.
mossy.diagnostics.statusHint.waiting: Ask a friend to share their world or add their address manually.
mossy.diagnostics.statusHint.visible: Return to Friends' worlds and choose one to join.
